result:
That's a profound question. If I could change one thing in the world, I would want to create a fundamental shift towards empathy and understanding between people. 

Imagine a world where, before reacting with anger or judgment, there was a genuine pause to understand the perspective, history, and humanity of the other person. It wouldn't erase differences or solve every problem instantly, but it could transform conflict into conversation and competition into collaboration. It might make us more careful with our words, more open to being wrong, and more willing to build bridges where we've built walls.

In my view, so many of our challenges—from the personal to the global—stem from this deficit. It feels like the root system that, if strengthened, could help heal so many branches of human struggle.

What do you think? If you could change one thing, what would it be?
